planets.name: WASP-22 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Tojil with a 3.53-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-22 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Tojil. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 3.53272912, pl_radj 1.23, pl_bmassj 0.67

quotes.title: WASP-22
quotes.card: It hosts one known exoplanet, WASP-22b; the nature of a likely third body is unclear.
